capture_dimensions: 3D Modeler Python/Rust frames are 1280x840 logical and physical at 96 DPI / 100% scale; Bambu Studio screenshot is 2553x1385 pixels.
capture_method: Visible native application windows captured from the desktop; paired sequence ran Python first, then Rust. The Bambu screenshot was captured after the installed slicer opened the staged STL.
known_capture_limit: Rust Light cancellation was not confirmed natively. Rust Dark and Python Light/Dark have confirmed native cancellation; Rust Light captures show running, successful retry, Subdivide completion, and resource-limit failure.
